target_pattern: Use redundant indirect object pronouns le and les with high-frequency indirect-object verbs even when the recipient is explicitly named with a plus person.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Removing le or les when recipient is already mentioned.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish commonly keeps indirect object pronouns with many verbs regardless of whether a plus recipient phrase is present.
target_pattern_formula: core frame: le or les plus verb plus direct object plus a plus person
recipient can be omitted while pronoun remains
le marks singular recipient, les marks plural recipients
high-frequency verbs: dar decir contar comprar traer mandar enviar pedir robar quitar prestar devolver
pronoun appears before conjugated verb in standard order
natural_examples: Le di el libro a Juan.
Le dije la verdad a Maria.
Le mande una carta a Pedro.
Les prestamos el coche a mis vecinos.
Le quitaron el telefono a Marta.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Le di el libro a Juan. -> change recipient to plural mis amigos.
Base: Le dije la verdad a Maria. -> change direct object to una mentira.
Base: Le conte un cuento a mi hijo. -> change recipient to mi hija.
Base: Le compre un coche a mi esposa. -> change object to una computadora.
Base: Le traje flores a mi madre. -> change object to chocolate.
Base: Le mande una carta a Pedro. -> change verb to enviar.
Base: Le pedi un favor a Juanita. -> change direct object to dinero.
Base: Le robaron el bolso a Marta. -> change noun to el telefono.
Base: Le quite el juguete al nino. -> change recipient to plural los ninos.
Base: Le preste la bicicleta a Luisa. -> change object to mi coche.
Base: Le devolviste el libro a tu profesor? -> change recipient to plural tus profesores.
Base: Les di las noticias a mis padres. -> change verb tense to preterite first plural.
Base: Les mandamos los documentos a los clientes. -> change direct object to singular el contrato.
Base: Le conte un chiste a mi amigo. -> change subject to plural nosotros.
Base: Les quitamos los telefonos a los estudiantes. -> change to singular recipient el estudiante.

common_errors.mistake: Le or les omitted with named recipient
common_errors.why_it_happens: English does not duplicate indirect object this way.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Keep redundant pronoun with common indirect-object verbs.

common_errors.mistake: Lo or la used for recipient role
common_errors.why_it_happens: Direct and indirect object functions are confused.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use le or les for recipient.
Use le for one recipient and les for more than one.
Use with verbs that naturally take indirect objects in this frame.
Place clitic pronoun before conjugated verb.

common_errors.mistake: A plus person omitted when recipient is explicit
common_errors.why_it_happens: Learner expects pronoun to be sufficient.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Keep a plus person phrase when naming recipient.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Chunk memorized only in singular form.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Switch to les for plural recipients.

common_errors.mistake: Redundancy treated as optional in natural speech
common_errors.correct_spanish: This redundancy is expected and fluent in Spanish.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Recipient and source readings overlap without context.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use clear context and complete clause.
Use clitic doubling naturally to sound native-like.
